sources.title: Run Qwen3.8-27B Locally | Atomic Chat
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is a dense 27.8B-parameter multimodal model from Alibaba's Qwen team, released on August 14, 2026. It reads text, images and video, carries a 262,144-token context window, and ships under Apache 2.0, so it can run locally in Atomic Chat without an API key.
